Some people say weekends are to wind down. Reset. Go off the grid. Catch up with the rest of life. Especially with friends, family, yourself.

Other people say weekends are for planning. Charting. Analyzing. Going back and replaying your trades. Improving on what you could have done better. Reading up on finance while market is closed. Preparing for the next week’s market open. Never stop.

Then of course there is the middle ground, a hybrid/mixture composed of the two said above.

I say there is no right or wrong here. Everyone’s situation and lifestyle are completely different from one another. You do what you need to do. 

And let’s be a little real, I KNOW YOU BE THINKING ABOUT STOCKS all the time. Lol. Be honest. There’s a little degen in us if you are reading this. You know it, I know it.

So when they finally do introduce actual weekend $SPY and $QQQ trading early 2027, it will be very interesting to see how that shapes the weekend landscape of Fintwit…
